svg.title: Scale Explorer · scale drawing
svg.desc: Each line represents its stated dimension. Dashed dimension lines are distances, not object diameters. This compares lengths; it does not map positions, areas or volumes. Model length = real length × 1.26 × 10⁻⁸. One model centimetre represents 796000 m. The Earth: 1.27 × 10⁷ m · across → 160 mm The Moon: 3.48 × 10⁶ m · across → 43.6 mm 10 mm calibration ruler Print at 100% scale. Check the 10 mm ruler with a real ruler; fit-to-page printing changes the dimensions. Each line represents its stated dimension. Dashed dimension lines are distances, not object diameters. This compares lengths; it does not map positions, areas or volumes. Dashed locators mark dimensions below 0.5 mm without enlarging them.
